purpose: Mechanical translation of the preregistered advancement language into report calculations.
metric_view: raw uncalibrated probabilities for all accuracy and probability-loss gates
probability_loss_mapping: Use cross_entropy when evaluation rows contain public soft target distributions; otherwise use nll. Cross entropy is the expected negative log likelihood under the target distribution.

seen_tasks.rows: the identical common test rows stored in each endpoint evaluation
seen_tasks.combined_win: expanded accuracy > paired control accuracy; require at least two of three seeds
seen_tasks.mean_nll: equal-seed mean expanded raw NLL <= equal-seed mean control raw NLL
seen_tasks.maximum_task_seed_regression: for every source and seed, expanded accuracy - control accuracy >= -0.02
seen_tasks.retained_task_mean: within an endpoint, arithmetic mean of retained-source raw accuracies; equal-seed mean expanded >= equal-seed mean control

fresh_blind_tasks.rows: the sealed release blind suite only
fresh_blind_tasks.combined_win: expanded accuracy > paired control accuracy; require at least two of three seeds
fresh_blind_tasks.mean_accuracy: equal-seed mean expanded raw accuracy > equal-seed mean control raw accuracy
fresh_blind_tasks.mean_nll: equal-seed mean expanded raw NLL <= equal-seed mean control raw NLL
fresh_blind_tasks.maximum_task_seed_regression: for every source and seed, expanded accuracy - control accuracy >= -0.02

candidate_prior.context_advantage: for every expanded seed and blind source, mean calibrated gold log probability under full context minus null context > 0
candidate_prior.cross_seed_null_js: generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence using each endpoint's validation temperature, averaged over blind rows; expanded mean <= control mean + 0.01

release_decision: All gates are conjunctive. If all pass, only seed1701-expanded is eligible. Replication seeds cannot substitute for seed 1701.
